segments.he: ספרו לפני רבינו ז"ל על הרה"צ ר' שלמה קרלינר ז"ל שאמר אם אין דגים בשבת השבת אינו שבת "אזמען האט קיין פיש ניט אוף שבת איז דער שבת קיין שבת ניט" (כי הוא החמיר מאד בדגים על שבת ומובא בבית אהרן שאמר אם אין דגים על שבת ידאג יותר ממה שכתוב בו ידאג כל השנה (היינו מקרה ביו"כ) ענה רבינו ז"ל ואמר מה ענין דגים אצל שבת. שבת הוא שבת ודגים הוא דגים. וויא קומט שבת ציא פיש. שבת איז שבת אין פיש איז פיש" (היינו התחזקות של רבינו שמחזק שאפילו אם אין הדבר כמו שצריך אל יפול מזה ויחי' במה שיכול עדיין):
segments.en: Once — after Purim that year — the ruffians on Purim broke all the windows of the Breslov kloiz in Uman, through the incitement and instigation of the Rabbi of Savran in Uman: "If everyone took one brick, nothing would remain of the kloiz." And they nearly destroyed the kloiz entirely — were it not for the fear that fell upon them from the distinguished men of the city who supported our fellowship. And it goes without saying what satisfaction Moharan'as had from this Purim — seeing the windows and doors broken and the kloiz nearly entirely destroyed. Yet despite this he strengthened himself then to fulfill the joy of Purim, as is cited in his letters. And then on Erev Shabbos parshas Parah when he went to the bathhouse in Uman, the opponents fell upon him and burned his clothes. But Reb Meir Blechir was with him and brought him other clothes. And throughout that winter — even though the fellowship from all places and the Breslov fellowship and his family from there sent him urgent letters imploring him for G-d's sake not to return to Breslov because they would literally kill him — despite all this, he was strong within himself that he would return, only he would extend his stay in Uman a little longer in prayer at the holy grave. And always when he returned to Reb Naftali's home he said: "It seems I still cannot return home."
